ratios.quote: The 2023 CoBank Credit Agreement contains a financial covenant (as further defined in the 2023 CoBank Credit Agreement) that imposes a maximum Total Net Leverage Ratio of 3.25 to 1.0, measured quarterly

Alaska Communications is required to maintain financial ratios, including (a) a maximum Consolidated Net Total Leverage Ratio (as defined in the 2024 Alaska Credit Agreement) of 4.75:1.00, stepping down to 4.50:1.00 beginning with the third quarter of 2027
a minimum Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of not less than 1.25 :1.00
On May 5, 2022, the Net Leverage Ratio was amended to 7.0 to 1.0 through the original maturity date.

parsed.notes: No actual ratio values are disclosed; only covenant limits. CoBank and Alaska covenants are measured quarterly; Alaska leverage limit steps down to 4.50x from Q3 2027 and 4.25x from Q3 2028. The Alaska covenants apply to subsidiary Alaska Communications (consolidated). The OneVI covenant (ratio of indebtedness to annual operating cash flow) is tested annually; the company was in compliance as of December 31, 2025, and the 7.0x limit applied through the original July 1, 2026 maturity; the excerpt is cut off before any post-amendment terms. Ratios governing interest margins and unused fees were excluded.
